description: Odoo virtual employee via MCP: query, create, modify records, workflows, PDFs, and activities.
name: io.github.singleflo/odoo-assistant

environmentVariables.description: Odoo database name. Optional: discovered automatically when the instance serves exactly one database; required when it serves several (the error names them).
environmentVariables.name: ODOO_DB

environmentVariables.description: Odoo login username. Optional: omitted, the login is discovered from the API key.
environmentVariables.name: ODOO_USER

environmentVariables.description: Odoo API key (Odoo 14+ required). Generate under Preferences / My Profile > Account Security > New API Key. Passwords are not accepted.
environmentVariables.name: ODOO_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Safety ceiling 0-5, default 3 (state transitions allowed, destructive ops blocked). See server_safety.py.
environmentVariables.name: ODOO_MCP_MAX_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated hosts this server refuses to WRITE to (requires ODOO_ALLOW_PROD_WRITE=yes to override). Empty by default: protection is the operator's opt-in, no host is baked in.
environmentVariables.name: ODOO_MCP_PROTECTED_HOSTS
